$comment: Which of the vendored conformance scenarios FountainKit runs. `yes` means it must pass; an object records a deliberate, explained deviation. Keep every scenario listed — an unlisted one fails the harness, so a synced-in scenario can never pass unnoticed.

auth-bearer-and-user-agent.skip: The bearer half holds and is covered by RequestBuildingTests. The User-Agent half asks for a `fountain-sdk-` prefix, which is the official SDK family's identity: FountainKit is a third-party client and identifies as `swift-goat/<version>`. Claiming the SDK's name in a deployment's access log would be a lie, so this one stays skipped rather than gamed.
